0022600111.text: The Suns (0-1, 15th in the West and 5th in the Pacific) host the Warriors (0-1, 13th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific) in Phoenix's second game of the season, and Phoenix has yet to play a home game this year. Mark Williams is out after shoulder surgery, while Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Golden State is missing Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and the teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, following a 2025-26 season series in which the Suns lost 1-3 and a February 5, 2026 meeting in Phoenix that the Suns lost 101-97.
